# hiok_hybrid_resource (Resource)

An on-premise server, VM, cluster or device monitored through HIOK Anywhere. The agent key is only in state right after creation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `resource_type` (String) server, vm, kubernetes, database or iotgateway.

### Optional

- `location` (String)

### Read-Only

- `agent_key` (String, Sensitive) Give this to the agent installer; shown once.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
